Subject: Aligning demo date, SSO contact, and procurement timeline

Hi Tom —

Thanks again for a productive discovery earlier today. Quick recap and a few asks so we can get the demo locked in and the right BrightPath folks looped in: 

Recap (two bullets):
- Primary use case: supply chain document parsing + redaction for PHI-sensitive claims.
- Success criteria: <30ms avg latency for inference on 4k seq, SOC2 evidence for SSO/authorization.

Proposed demo windows (pick one):
1) Tue, Oct 5 — 10:00–11:00 PT
2) Wed, Oct 6 — 14:00–15:00 PT
3) Thu, Oct 7 — 09:00–10:00 PT

Asks from your side:
- Please confirm the procurement POC and the SSO/identity owner who can provide a test SAML/Okta account or a short-term test user.
- Any network restrictions (IP allowlist) we should know about ahead of the session?

Attached: Demo-Agenda-BrightPath.pdf (short 30–45m agenda) and a SOC2-evidence-guide that lists common artifacts procurement asks for.

If you can reply with preferred slot + SSO contact, I’ll lock the calendar and share an invite that includes our platform engineer (Hannah) and Marissa (solutions engineer) to cover integrations and procurement questions.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

—Sean Gallagher
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

All —

Locked in: Wed, Oct 6 · 14:00–15:00 PT. I’ve sent a calendar invite to everyone on this thread (please accept when you see it). Quick logistics and action items before the session: 

1) SSO test account / handshake: Priya, can you share either (a) a short-lived test user (email + password) to demonstrate SAML assertions, or (b) SAML metadata for an Okta dev org we can import? If you prefer a secure channel, reply to marissa.cole@redwood.ai and we’ll provide an encrypted upload.

2) Procurement packet: Janelle / procurement@ — we’ve attached the SOC2-evidence-guide and a procurement checklist. If you have a PO template or routing constraints (DocuSign signer order), please send by Oct 1 so we can include it in the follow-up.

3) Internal roster: Hannah will present the integration steps and Grace O'Connor (platform engineering) will be on for the deployment slide (she’ll join the invite).

4) Test data: Tom — please confirm which redaction example you want us to demo (claims doc vs. EOB).

Post-demo we’ll share a short recording, the SOC2 artifact list, and a mutual action plan with milestones and owners (I’ll create the MAP in HubSpot and link the ID here).

HubSpot record: https://app.redwood.ai/hubspot/record/BP-2026-0921

Thanks everyone — see you on Oct 6.
